page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached storage.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed environments. Because the CPU allocation is dedicated with a single thread per physical core, workloads benefit from consistent compute performance without hyper-threading overhead. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this hardware profile offers high resource density for enterprise workloads, though the lack of bundled local storage requires planning for network storage resources.

This server configuration is suited for large-scale general-purpose applications, high-concurrency web serving, enterprise databases, and distributed middleware. The combination of 128 dedicated cores and 64 Gbps network bandwidth also supports intensive containerized deployments and CI/CD orchestration pipelines that require predictable CPU performance.
